description: This PHP source file defines the AutoTOCAdder class, which adds a Table of Contents placeholder to Markdown documents if specific conditions are met, such as enabling automatic TOC and absence of existing TOC. It interacts with the CommonMark library for Markdown parsing and extends configuration behavior.

classes.name: AutoTOCAdder
classes.description: A class responsible for adding a Table of Contents placeholder to Markdown documents during parsing, based on configuration settings.

methods.name: onDocumentParsed
methods.description: Event handler that adds a TOC placeholder if automatic TOC is enabled and no placeholder exists.

methods.name: isAutoTOC
methods.description: Checks the configuration to determine if automatic Table of Contents is enabled.

methods.name: hasTOCPlaceholder
methods.description: Determines if the current Markdown document already contains a TOC placeholder.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration object for the class.
